mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_file_object (id, sha256, file_size, bucket_name, object_key, storage_version, storage_tier, status, reference_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, UNHEX(#{sha256Hex}), #{fileSize}, #{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, #{storageVersion}, #{storageTier}, #{status}, #{referenceCount}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, LOWER(HEX(sha256)) AS sha256Hex, file_size, bucket_name, object_key, storage_version, storage_tier, status, reference_count FROM iam_file_object WHERE id = #{objectId}

SELECT f.tenant_id, f.id AS fileId, f.object_id, o.bucket_name, o.object_key, f.version FROM iam_file f JOIN iam_file_object o ON o.id = f.object_id WHERE f.status = 'DELETED' AND f.legal_hold = 0 AND ( (f.retention_until IS NOT NULL AND f.retention_until <= #{retentionDue}) OR (f.retention_until IS NULL AND f.created_at <= #{createdBeforeCutoff}) ) ORDER BY f.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_file_reference WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND active_slot = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_file_reference (id, tenant_id, file_id, resource_id, resource_instance_key, reference_type, field_id, sort_order, status, active_slot, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reference.id}, #{reference.tenantId}, #{reference.fileId}, #{reference.resourceId}, #{reference.resourceInstanceKey}, #{reference.referenceType}, #{reference.fieldId}, #{reference.sortOrder}, #{reference.status}, #{reference.activeSlot}, #{reference.version}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, file_id, resource_id, resource_instance_key, reference_type, field_id, sort_order, status, active_slot, version FROM iam_file_reference WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{referenceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_file (id, tenant_id, object_id, file_name, extension, declared_content_type, detected_content_type, file_size, sha256, owner_user_id, status, scan_status, retention_until, legal_hold, delete_marker, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{file.id}, #{file.tenantId}, #{file.objectId}, #{file.fileName}, NULL, #{file.declaredContentType}, NULL, #{file.fileSize}, UNHEX(#{file.sha256Hex}), #{file.ownerUserId}, #{file.status}, #{file.scanStatus}, NULL, #{file.legalHold}, #{file.deleteMarker}, #{file.version}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, object_id, file_name, declared_content_type, file_size, LOWER(HEX(sha256)) AS sha256Hex, owner_user_id, status, scan_status, legal_hold, delete_marker, version FROM iam_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{fileId}
SELECT id FROM iam_file WHERE status = 'VERIFYING' AND scan_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: FROM iam_file f JOIN iam_file_scan_record r ON r.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND r.file_id = f.id AND r.scan_attempt = ( SELECT MAX(r2.scan_attempt) FROM iam_file_scan_record r2 WHERE r2.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND r2.file_id = f.id) WHERE f.status = 'SCANNING' AND f.scan_status = 'FAILED' AND r.result = 'FAILED'
mapper.select:
SELECT f.id AS fileId, f.tenant_id, f.file_name, f.declared_content_type, f.file_size, LOWER(HEX(f.sha256)) AS sha256Hex, f.version, r.scan_attempt AS lastAttempt, r.completed_at AS lastCompletedAt
ORDER BY r.completed_at ASC, f.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id, id AS fileId, #{attempt} AS attempt, file_name, declared_content_type, file_size, LOWER(HEX(sha256)) AS sha256Hex, version FROM iam_file WHERE id = #{fileId} AND status = 'SCANNING' AND scan_status = 'SCANNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_file_scan_record (id, tenant_id, file_id, scan_attempt, scanner, signature_version, result, threat_code, error_code, started_at, completed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{fileId}, #{attempt}, #{scanner}, NULL, 'SCANNING', NULL, NULL, #{startedAt}, NULL, #{now})

INSERT INTO iam_file_upload_part (id, tenant_id, upload_session_id, part_number, part_size, part_sha256, storage_etag, status, uploaded_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{uploadSessionId}, #{partNumber}, #{partSize}, UNHEX(#{partSha256Hex}), #{storageEtag}, #{status}, #{uploadedAt}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE part_size = VALUES(part_size), part_sha256 = VALUES(part_sha256), storage_etag = VALUES(storage_etag), status = VALUES(status), uploaded_at = VALUES(uploaded_at), version = version + 1, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, upload_session_id, part_number, part_size, LOWER(HEX(part_sha256)) AS partSha256Hex, storage_etag, status, uploaded_at, version FROM iam_file_upload_part WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND upload_session_id = #{uploadSessionId} ORDER BY part_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_file_upload_session (id, tenant_id, user_id, file_name, file_size, whole_sha256, declared_content_type, storage_upload_id, bucket_name, object_key, part_size, part_count, uploaded_part_count, status, expire_at, completed_file_id, failure_code, quota_reservation_bytes, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{session.id}, #{session.tenantId}, #{session.userId}, #{session.fileName}, #{session.fileSize}, UNHEX(#{session.wholeSha256Hex}), #{session.declaredContentType}, #{session.storageUploadId}, #{session.bucketName}, #{session.objectKey}, #{session.partSize}, #{session.partCount}, #{session.uploadedPartCount}, #{session.status}, #{session.expireAt}, #{session.completedFileId}, NULL, #{session.quotaReservationBytes}, #{session.version}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, user_id, file_name, file_size, LOWER(HEX(whole_sha256)) AS wholeSha256Hex, declared_content_type, storage_upload_id, bucket_name, object_key, part_size, part_count, uploaded_part_count, status, expire_at, completed_file_id, quota_reservation_bytes, version FROM iam_file_upload_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{uploadId}
SELECT tenant_id, quota_bytes, used_logical_bytes, reserved_bytes, version FROM iam_file_tenant_quota
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM iam_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status NOT IN ('DELETED','PURGING','PURGED')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quota_reservation_bytes), 0) FROM iam_file_upload_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('INIT','UPLOADING','VERIFYING','MERGING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_file_dr_drill_log (id, tenant_id, scenario_code, target_rpo_seconds, actual_rpo_seconds, target_rto_seconds, actual_rto_seconds, verified_objects, status, executed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{scenarioCode}, #{targetRpoSeconds}, #{actualRpoSeconds}, #{targetRtoSeconds}, #{actualRtoSeconds}, #{verifiedObjects}, #{status}, #{executedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, scenario_code, target_rpo_seconds, actual_rpo_seconds, target_rto_seconds, actual_rto_seconds, verified_objects, status, executed_at FROM iam_file_dr_drill_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY executed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50
